BackstoryDef.title: Dragonstone terrace child
BackstoryDef.description: Raised on dark volcanic soil, they helped cultivate small fields and gardens wherever the stone allowed.

BackstoryDef.title: Volcanic forge apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: They learned metalwork in a culture that still measured craftsmen against impossible legends of old Valyria.

BackstoryDef.title: Obsidian quarry child
BackstoryDef.description: Black volcanic glass and strange dark stone surrounded them from childhood.

BackstoryDef.title: Valyrian mosaic student
BackstoryDef.description: They copied dragons, twisting flames, and ancient geometric designs found in surviving Valyrian art.

BackstoryDef.title: Ward of the Old Blood
BackstoryDef.description: Fostered among another Valyrian-descended family, they studied bloodlines, High Valyrian phrases, and ancient histories.

BackstoryDef.title: Heir of the Dragonblood
BackstoryDef.description: Their education emphasized lineage, rule, languages, and the heavy expectations placed on those claiming the blood of old Valyria.

BackstoryDef.title: Second son of Dragonstone
BackstoryDef.description: Without an assured inheritance, they trained for military or household service and spent long hours around horses and hunting beasts.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragonseed
BackstoryDef.description: Whispers of Valyrian ancestry followed them despite their uncertain birth, bringing both fascination and resentment.

BackstoryDef.title: Cliffside shepherd
BackstoryDef.description: They tended livestock across black cliffs and windswept slopes overlooking the narrow sea.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragon Guard page
BackstoryDef.description: Serving warriors of a Valyrian household introduced them to disciplined combat and the less glamorous work of tending injuries.

BackstoryDef.title: Blacksoil vintner
BackstoryDef.description: They cultivated vines and hardy crops in volcanic earth shaped by wind, salt, and stone.

BackstoryDef.title: Valyrian forge master
BackstoryDef.description: They cannot recreate the legendary secrets of Valyrian steel, but generations of metallurgical tradition still guide their work.

BackstoryDef.title: Blackstone mason
BackstoryDef.description: They specialize in working dark volcanic stone into keeps, towers, roads, and monumental architecture.

BackstoryDef.title: Narrow Sea hunter
BackstoryDef.description: They hunt seabirds, goats, and coastal game while reading weather almost as carefully as tracks.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragon motif artisan
BackstoryDef.description: Their carvings and metalwork preserve dragons, flames, and the elaborate imagery associated with Valyrian bloodlines.

BackstoryDef.title: Blood and Fire healer
BackstoryDef.description: They combine practical medicine with old family traditions, some learned and others half-remembered from ancient texts.

BackstoryDef.title: High Valyrian scholar
BackstoryDef.description: They study High Valyrian, surviving histories of the Freehold, genealogies, and fragments of knowledge left after the Doom.

BackstoryDef.title: Valyrian household guard
BackstoryDef.description: They serve a household obsessed with lineage and survival, guarding against enemies both political and physical.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragonstone steward
BackstoryDef.description: They manage servants, stores, ships, estates, and the complicated genealogies of a Valyrian-descended House.

BackstoryDef.title: Old Blood envoy
BackstoryDef.description: Fluent in lineage and ceremony, they represent a culture whose pride reaches back to the Freehold and the Doom itself.
